summary: <cite index="18-3,22-8">The July CPI report released Wednesday showed headline inflation rose 0.1% month-over-month and 3.4% year-over-year</cite>, coming in cooler than some expectations and <cite index="2-1">reinforcing bets the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates next month</cite>. <cite index="39-10,39-11">The July producer price index released Thursday was flat, below the 0.2% expected gain</cite>, further supporting dovish sentiment. <cite index="1-6">Stocks rose after the key inflation report, while upbeat earnings from several technology companies helped support sentiment</cite>. <cite index="1-7,1-8">CoreWeave surged 18% after narrowing losses and meeting revenue expectations, while Super Micro Computer jumped 9% after beating earnings</cite>. <cite index="39-1">Tapestry fell 8.8% after offering disappointing guidance despite beating fourth-quarter earnings expectations</cite>. <cite index="6-2,6-3">Wendy's surged more than 13% after a Financial Times report that investor Nelson Peltz is preparing a bid to take the company private through Trian Fund Management</cite>. <cite index="3-7">Geopolitical tensions continue as Iran said the Strait of Hormuz remains under its control after President Trump made statements about the waterway</cite>.

signals.title: July CPI and PPI data come in below expectations
signals.desc: Headline CPI rose just 0.1% monthly and PPI was flat versus 0.2% expected, reducing near-term rate hike odds and supporting risk assets.

signals.title: CoreWeave and Super Micro beat earnings expectations
signals.desc: AI infrastructure names delivered strong results with CoreWeave up 18% and SMCI up 9%, signaling continued strength in AI capex spending.

signals.title: Nelson Peltz prepares bid to take Wendy's private
signals.desc: Trian Fund Management is working on a buyout offer for Wendy's with co-investors, sending shares up over 13% on M&A speculation.

signals.title: Tapestry guidance disappoints despite earnings beat
signals.desc: Luxury holding company fell 8.8% after offering weak forward outlook, signaling softening consumer demand for premium goods.

signals.title: Iran reaffirms control over Strait of Hormuz
signals.desc: Tehran's statement following Trump comments maintains geopolitical uncertainty but oil prices declined on the day, suggesting markets are pricing in contained risks.

verdict: Cooler inflation data and solid tech earnings drive equities toward fresh highs while reducing Fed hawkish pressure for September.
